" ============================================================================
" Line comment / uncomment functions - multi-filetype support
" F3: comment line(s),  F4: uncomment line(s)
" ============================================================================

" Return the comment symbol for the current filetype
function! GetCommentSymbol()
    let filetype = &filetype
    
    if filetype == 'python'
        return '#'
    elseif filetype == 'vim'
        return '"'
    elseif filetype == 'verilog' || filetype == 'systemverilog'
        return '//'
    elseif filetype == 'c' || filetype == 'cpp'
        return '//'
    elseif filetype == 'javascript' || filetype == 'typescript'
        return '//'
    elseif filetype == 'java'
        return '//'
    elseif filetype == 'rust'
        return '//'
    elseif filetype == 'go'
        return '//'
    elseif filetype == 'sh' || filetype == 'bash'
        return '#'
    elseif filetype == 'ruby'
        return '#'
    elseif filetype == 'perl'
        return '#'
    elseif filetype == 'lua'
        return '--'
    elseif filetype == 'sql'
        return '--'
    elseif filetype == 'tcl'
        return '#'
    else
        " Check special filenames
        let filename = expand('%:t')
        
        if filename == 'cshrc' || filename == '.cshrc'
            return '#'
        elseif filename == 'tcshrc' || filename == '.tcshrc'
            return '#'
        elseif filename == 'zshrc' || filename == '.zshrc'
            return '#'
        elseif filename =~ '\.sdc$'
            return '#'
        endif
        
        " Default
        return '#'
    endif
endfunction

" Add line comment
function! CommentLine()
    let comment = GetCommentSymbol()
    let current_line = getline('.')
    
    " Skip if already commented
    if current_line =~ '^' . escape(comment, '/') . '\s'
        return
    endif
    
    " Insert comment symbol at column 0
    call setline('.', comment . ' ' . current_line)
endfunction

" Remove line comment
function! UncommentLine()
    let comment = GetCommentSymbol()
    let current_line = getline('.')
    
    " Build pattern to match comment prefix (with optional leading whitespace)
    let comment_pattern = '^\(\s*\)' . escape(comment, '/') . '\s\?'
    
    " Strip comment symbol if found, preserve indentation
    if current_line =~ comment_pattern
        call setline('.', substitute(current_line, comment_pattern, '\1', ''))
    endif
endfunction

" Key mappings
nnoremap <F3> :call CommentLine()<CR>
nnoremap <F4> :call UncommentLine()<CR>
nnoremap <F5> :call FormatWithVerible()<CR>

" Visual mode mappings (comment/uncomment multiple lines)
vnoremap <F3> :call VisualCommentLine()<CR>
vnoremap <F4> :call VisualUncommentLine()<CR>
vnoremap <F5> <Esc>:call FormatWithVerible()<CR>

" Comment selected lines in visual mode
function! VisualCommentLine()
    let comment = GetCommentSymbol()
    " Get selected line range
    let start_line = line("'<")
    let end_line = line("'>")
    
    for line_num in range(start_line, end_line)
        let current_line = getline(line_num)
        
        " Preserve indentation
        let indent = matchstr(current_line, '^\s*')
        let content = substitute(current_line, '^\s*', '', '')
        
        " Skip empty lines
        if empty(content)
            continue
        endif
        
        " Skip if already commented
        if current_line !~ '^' . escape(comment, '/') . '\s'
            call setline(line_num, comment . ' ' . current_line)
        endif
    endfor
endfunction

" Uncomment selected lines in visual mode
function! VisualUncommentLine()
    let comment = GetCommentSymbol()
    let start_line = line("'<")
    let end_line = line("'>")
    
    let comment_pattern = '^\(\s*\)' . escape(comment, '/') . '\s\?'
    
    for line_num in range(start_line, end_line)
        let current_line = getline(line_num)
        
        if current_line =~ comment_pattern
            call setline(line_num, substitute(current_line, comment_pattern, '\1', ''))
        endif
    endfor
endfunction

" Format current verilog/systemverilog buffer with verible-verilog-format
function! FormatWithVerible()
    if executable('verible-verilog-format') == 0
        echohl ErrorMsg
        echom 'verible-verilog-format not found in PATH'
        echohl None
        return
    endif

    if &filetype != 'verilog' && &filetype != 'systemverilog'
        echohl ErrorMsg
        echom 'F5 formatter only supports verilog/systemverilog buffers'
        echohl None
        return
    endif

    let l:view = winsaveview()
    let l:filepath = expand('%:p')
    let l:cmd = 'verible-verilog-format --stdin_name=' . shellescape(l:filepath) . ' -'

    let l:lines = getline(1, '$')
    let l:input = join(l:lines, "\n")
    if &endofline || len(l:lines) == 0
        let l:input .= "\n"
    endif

    let l:output = systemlist(l:cmd, l:input)
    if v:shell_error != 0
        echohl ErrorMsg
        echom 'verible-verilog-format failed (exit code: ' . v:shell_error . ')'
        echohl None
        return
    endif

    call setline(1, l:output)
    if line('$') > len(l:output)
        execute (len(l:output) + 1) . ',$delete _'
    endif

    call winrestview(l:view)
    echom 'Formatted with verible-verilog-format'
endfunction

" ============================================================================
" Usage:
" - Source this file from your gvimrc:  source /path/to/comment_toggle.vim
" - F3: comment current line or visual selection
" - F4: uncomment current line or visual selection
" - F5: format current verilog/systemverilog buffer with verible-verilog-format
" - Supported filetypes: python, vim, verilog, systemverilog, c, cpp,
"                         javascript, typescript, java, rust, go, sh, bash,
"                         ruby, perl, lua, sql, tcl, cshrc, tcshrc, zshrc,
"                         .sdc files
" ============================================================================

```

" ============================================================================
" Verible formatter mapping for gVim
" F5: format current verilog/systemverilog buffer using verible-verilog-format
" ============================================================================

function! FormatWithVerible()
    if executable('verible-verilog-format') == 0
        echohl ErrorMsg
        echom 'verible-verilog-format not found in PATH'
        echohl None
        return
    endif

    if &filetype != 'verilog' && &filetype != 'systemverilog'
        echohl ErrorMsg
        echom 'F5 formatter only supports verilog/systemverilog buffers'
        echohl None
        return
    endif

    let l:view = winsaveview()
    let l:filepath = expand('%:p')
    let l:cmd = 'verible-verilog-format --stdin_name=' . shellescape(l:filepath) . ' -'

    let l:lines = getline(1, '$')
    let l:input = join(l:lines, "\n")
    if &endofline || len(l:lines) == 0
        let l:input .= "\n"
    endif

    let l:output = systemlist(l:cmd, l:input)
    if v:shell_error != 0
        echohl ErrorMsg
        echom 'verible-verilog-format failed (exit code: ' . v:shell_error . ')'
        echohl None
        return
    endif

    call setline(1, l:output)
    if line('$') > len(l:output)
        execute (len(l:output) + 1) . ',$delete _'
    endif

    call winrestview(l:view)
    echom 'Formatted with verible-verilog-format'
endfunction

" ============================================================================
" Line comment / uncomment functions - multi-filetype support
" F3: comment line(s),  F4: uncomment line(s)
" ============================================================================

" Return the comment symbol for the current filetype
function! GetCommentSymbol()
    let filetype = &filetype
    
    if filetype == 'python'
        return '#'
    elseif filetype == 'vim'
        return '"'
    elseif filetype == 'verilog' || filetype == 'systemverilog'
        return '//'
    elseif filetype == 'c' || filetype == 'cpp'
        return '//'
    elseif filetype == 'javascript' || filetype == 'typescript'
        return '//'
    elseif filetype == 'java'
        return '//'
    elseif filetype == 'rust'
        return '//'
    elseif filetype == 'go'
        return '//'
    elseif filetype == 'sh' || filetype == 'bash'
        return '#'
    elseif filetype == 'ruby'
        return '#'
    elseif filetype == 'perl'
        return '#'
    elseif filetype == 'lua'
        return '--'
    elseif filetype == 'sql'
        return '--'
    elseif filetype == 'tcl'
        return '#'
    else
        " Check special filenames
        let filename = expand('%:t')
        
        if filename == 'cshrc' || filename == '.cshrc'
            return '#'
        elseif filename == 'tcshrc' || filename == '.tcshrc'
            return '#'
        elseif filename == 'zshrc' || filename == '.zshrc'
            return '#'
        elseif filename =~ '\.sdc$'
            return '#'
        endif
        
        " Default
        return '#'
    endif
endfunction

" Add line comment
function! CommentLine()
    let comment = GetCommentSymbol()
    let current_line = getline('.')
    
    " Skip if already commented
    if current_line =~ '^' . escape(comment, '/') . '\s'
        return
    endif
    
    " Insert comment symbol at column 0
    call setline('.', comment . ' ' . current_line)
endfunction

" Remove line comment
function! UncommentLine()
    let comment = GetCommentSymbol()
    let current_line = getline('.')
    
    " Build pattern to match comment prefix (with optional leading whitespace)
    let comment_pattern = '^\(\s*\)' . escape(comment, '/') . '\s\?'
    
    " Strip comment symbol if found, preserve indentation
    if current_line =~ comment_pattern
        call setline('.', substitute(current_line, comment_pattern, '\1', ''))
    endif
endfunction

" Key mappings
nnoremap <F3> :call CommentLine()<CR>
nnoremap <F4> :call UncommentLine()<CR>

" Visual mode mappings (comment/uncomment multiple lines)
vnoremap <F3> :call VisualCommentLine()<CR>
vnoremap <F4> :call VisualUncommentLine()<CR>

" Comment selected lines in visual mode
function! VisualCommentLine()
    let comment = GetCommentSymbol()
    " Get selected line range
    let start_line = line("'<")
    let end_line = line("'>")
    
    for line_num in range(start_line, end_line)
        let current_line = getline(line_num)
        
        " Preserve indentation
        let indent = matchstr(current_line, '^\s*')
        let content = substitute(current_line, '^\s*', '', '')
        
        " Skip empty lines
        if empty(content)
            continue
        endif
        
        " Skip if already commented
        if current_line !~ '^' . escape(comment, '/') . '\s'
            call setline(line_num, comment . ' ' . current_line)
        endif
    endfor
endfunction

" Uncomment selected lines in visual mode
function! VisualUncommentLine()
    let comment = GetCommentSymbol()
    let start_line = line("'<")
    let end_line = line("'>")
    
    let comment_pattern = '^\(\s*\)' . escape(comment, '/') . '\s\?'
    
    for line_num in range(start_line, end_line)
        let current_line = getline(line_num)
        
        if current_line =~ comment_pattern
            call setline(line_num, substitute(current_line, comment_pattern, '\1', ''))
        endif
    endfor
endfunction

" - F4: uncomment current line or visual selection

"                         javascript, typescript, java, rust, go, sh, bash,
"                         ruby, perl, lua, sql, tcl, cshrc, tcshrc, zshrc,
"                         .sdc files
" ============================================================================

我把 `verible_format.vim` 里的实现改成了：
1. 把当前 buffer 写到 `tempname().sv` 临时文件
2. 执行 `verible-verilog-format --inplace <tempfile>`
3. 读取格式化后的临时文件覆盖回当前 buffer
4. 删除临时文件

这样不再依赖 `systemlist(..., input)`，就不会再触发你看到的 `/tmp` 路径错误。

" ============================================================================
" Verible formatter mapping for gVim
" F5: format current verilog/systemverilog buffer using verible-verilog-format
" ============================================================================

function! FormatWithVerible()
    if executable('verible-verilog-format') == 0
        echohl ErrorMsg
        echom 'verible-verilog-format not found in PATH'
        echohl None
        return
    endif

    if &filetype != 'verilog' && &filetype != 'systemverilog'
        echohl ErrorMsg
        echom 'F5 formatter only supports verilog/systemverilog buffers'
        echohl None
        return
    endif

    let l:view = winsaveview()

    let l:tmpdir = ''
    if exists('$TEMP') && isdirectory($TEMP)
        let l:tmpdir = $TEMP
    elseif exists('$TMP') && isdirectory($TMP)
        let l:tmpdir = $TMP
    else
        let l:tmpdir = getcwd()
    endif

    let l:tmpfile = substitute(l:tmpdir, '[\\/]$', '', '') . '/verible_fmt_' . localtime() . '.sv'
    let l:lines = getline(1, '$')
    try
        call writefile(l:lines, l:tmpfile)
    catch
        echohl ErrorMsg
        echom 'failed to create temp file: ' . l:tmpfile
        echohl None
        return
    endtry

    let l:cmd = 'verible-verilog-format --inplace ' . shellescape(l:tmpfile)
    call system(l:cmd)
    if v:shell_error != 0
        call delete(l:tmpfile)
        echohl ErrorMsg
        echom 'verible-verilog-format failed (exit code: ' . v:shell_error . ')'
        echohl None
        return
    endif

    let l:output = readfile(l:tmpfile)
    call delete(l:tmpfile)

    call setline(1, l:output)
    if line('$') > len(l:output)
        execute (len(l:output) + 1) . ',$delete _'
    endif

    call winrestview(l:view)
    echom 'Formatted with verible-verilog-format'
endfunction

nnoremap <F5> :call FormatWithVerible()<CR>
vnoremap <F5> <Esc>:call FormatWithVerible()<CR>

```
</details></tool-use>

function! FormatWithVerible()
    if executable('verible-verilog-format') == 0
        echohl ErrorMsg
        echom 'verible-verilog-format not found in PATH'
        echohl None
        return
    endif

    if &filetype != 'verilog' && &filetype != 'systemverilog'
        echohl ErrorMsg

        echohl None
        return

    let l:view = winsaveview()

    if exists('$TEMP') && isdirectory($TEMP)

    elseif exists('$TMP') && isdirectory($TMP)
        let l:tmpdir = $TMP
    else

" ============================================================================
" Verible formatter mapping for gVim
" F5: format current verilog/systemverilog buffer using verible-verilog-format
" ============================================================================

function! FormatWithVerible()
    if executable('verible-verilog-format') == 0
        echohl ErrorMsg
        echom 'verible-verilog-format not found in PATH'
        echohl None
        return
    endif

    if &filetype != 'verilog' && &filetype != 'systemverilog'
        echohl ErrorMsg
        echom 'F5 formatter only supports verilog/systemverilog buffers'
        echohl None
        return
    endif

    let l:view = winsaveview()
    let l:lines = getline(1, '$')

    let l:candidate_dirs = []
    if exists('$LOCALAPPDATA')
        call add(l:candidate_dirs, $LOCALAPPDATA . '\\Temp')
    endif
    if exists('$USERPROFILE')
        call add(l:candidate_dirs, $USERPROFILE . '\\AppData\\Local\\Temp')
    endif
    if exists('$TEMP')
        call add(l:candidate_dirs, $TEMP)
    endif
    if exists('$TMP')
        call add(l:candidate_dirs, $TMP)
    endif
    call add(l:candidate_dirs, getcwd())
    call add(l:candidate_dirs, expand('~'))

    let l:tmpfile = ''
    let l:seed = localtime() . '_' . getpid() . '_' . str2nr(reltimefloat(reltime()) * 1000)
    for l:dir in l:candidate_dirs
        if empty(l:dir) || !isdirectory(l:dir)
            continue
        endif
        if (has('win32') || has('win64')) && l:dir =~ '^/'
            continue
        endif

        let l:candidate = substitute(l:dir, '[\\/]$', '', '') . '/verible_fmt_' . l:seed . '.sv'
        try
            call writefile(l:lines, l:candidate)
            let l:tmpfile = l:candidate
            break
        catch
        endtry
    endfor

    if empty(l:tmpfile)
        echohl ErrorMsg
        echom 'failed to create writable temp file (checked TEMP/TMP and current dir)'
        echohl None
        return
    endif

    let l:cmd = 'verible-verilog-format --inplace ' . shellescape(l:tmpfile)
    let l:save_shelltemp = &shelltemp
    set noshelltemp
    call system(l:cmd)
    let &shelltemp = l:save_shelltemp
    if v:shell_error != 0
        call delete(l:tmpfile)
        echohl ErrorMsg
        echom 'verible-verilog-format failed (exit code: ' . v:shell_error . ')'
        echohl None
        return
    endif

    let l:output = readfile(l:tmpfile)
    call delete(l:tmpfile)

    call setline(1, l:output)
    if line('$') > len(l:output)
        execute (len(l:output) + 1) . ',$delete _'
    endif

    call winrestview(l:view)
    echom 'Formatted with verible-verilog-format'
endfunction

" ============================================================================
" Verible formatter mapping for gVim
" F5: format current verilog/systemverilog buffer using verible-verilog-format
" ============================================================================

" Force Vim temp env vars to a writable Windows temp folder.
function! EnsureWindowsTempDir()
    if !(has('win32') || has('win64'))
        return
    endif

    let l:win_temp = ''
    if exists('$LOCALAPPDATA') && isdirectory($LOCALAPPDATA . '\\Temp')
        let l:win_temp = $LOCALAPPDATA . '\\Temp'
    elseif exists('$USERPROFILE') && isdirectory($USERPROFILE . '\\AppData\\Local\\Temp')
        let l:win_temp = $USERPROFILE . '\\AppData\\Local\\Temp'
    elseif exists('$TEMP') && isdirectory($TEMP) && $TEMP !~ '^/'
        let l:win_temp = $TEMP
    elseif exists('$TMP') && isdirectory($TMP) && $TMP !~ '^/'
        let l:win_temp = $TMP
    endif

    if empty(l:win_temp)
        return
    endif

    if !exists('$TEMP') || empty($TEMP) || $TEMP =~ '^/'
        let $TEMP = l:win_temp
    endif
    if !exists('$TMP') || empty($TMP) || $TMP =~ '^/'
        let $TMP = l:win_temp
    endif
    if !exists('$TMPDIR') || empty($TMPDIR) || $TMPDIR =~ '^/'
        let $TMPDIR = l:win_temp
    endif
endfunction

function! FormatWithVerible()

    if executable('verible-verilog-format') == 0
        echohl ErrorMsg

        call add(l:candidate_dirs, $LOCALAPPDATA . '\\Temp')

        call add(l:candidate_dirs, $USERPROFILE . '\\AppData\\Local\\Temp')

    if exists('$TEMP')
        call add(l:candidate_dirs, $TEMP)
    endif
    if exists('$TMP')
        call add(l:candidate_dirs, $TMP)
    endif
    call add(l:candidate_dirs, getcwd())
    call add(l:candidate_dirs, expand('~'))

    let l:tmpfile = ''
    let l:seed = localtime() . '_' . getpid() . '_' . str2nr(reltimefloat(reltime()) * 1000)

可以，完全可以改，而且这是你这个问题最本质的修复方向。

我已经先在 `verible_format.vim#L6` 里加了自动修正逻辑：

你还可以把下面这段放到你的 gvimrc（全局生效，推荐）：

```vim
if has('win32') || has('win64')
    let s:win_temp = $LOCALAPPDATA . '\Temp'
    if isdirectory(s:win_temp)
        let $TEMP = s:win_temp
        let $TMP = s:win_temp
        let $TMPDIR = s:win_temp
    endif
    unlet s:win_temp
endif
```

这样做之后，不只是 F5 格式化，其他依赖临时文件的 Vim 操作也会避开 /tmp。

_**Agent (copilot/auto)**_

这个报错的原因就是你用了 autoload 风格函数名：

`neoformat#formatters#verilog_systemverilog#...`

这种函数只能放在 Neoformat 对应的 autoload 脚本里，不能放在普通的 `verible_format.vim` 里，所以会报 `function name does not match script file name`。

我已经把 `verible_format.vim` 改成普通的 Neoformat 配置变量写法，不再定义这类函数了。现在内容是：

```vim
let g:neoformat_enabled_verilog_systemverilog = ['verible_format']

let g:neoformat_verilog_systemverilog_verible_format = {
    \ 'exe': 'verible-verilog-format',
    \ 'args': ['--column_limit=200', '--indentation_space=4', '-'],
    \ 'stderr': 1,
    \ 'stdin': 1,
    \ }
```

这样 `source` 这个文件时就不会再触发那个函数名和脚本名不匹配的错误了。

如果你后面想走 Neoformat 官方那种 `neoformat#formatters#...` 函数方案，我也可以帮你把文件放到正确的 autoload

怎么使用这个

---

_**Agent (copilot/auto)**_

现在这份 `verible_format.vim` 不是“直接按 F5 调函数”的脚本了，而是给 Neoformat 提供配置。

用法分两步。

1. 先让 gVim 读到这份配置  
在你的 gvimrc 里加一行：

```vim
source c:/Users/man/Desktop/code/verible_format.vim
```

如果你不想改 gvimrc，也可以每次手动执行：

```vim
:source c:/Users/man/Desktop/code/verible_format.vim
```

2. 在 Verilog/SystemVerilog 文件里执行 Neoformat

```vim
:Neoformat
```

如果 Neoformat 正常识别到这份配置，它就会调用 `verible-verilog-format` 来格式化当前文件。

如果你想继续绑定到 F5，可以在 gvimrc 再加一行：

```vim
autocmd FileType verilog,systemverilog nnoremap <buffer> <F5> :Neoformat<CR>
```

这样进入 `verilog` 或 `systemverilog` 文件后，按 `F5` 就会跑 Neoformat。

你还需要满足两个前提：
1. 已安装 Neoformat 插件
2. `verible-verilog-format` 已经在 PATH 里，命令行直接能运行

最简单的验证方式是：
1. 打开一个 `.v` 或 `.sv` 文件
2. 执行 `:source c:/Users/man/Desktop/code/verible_format.vim`
3. 执行 `:Neoformat`

如果没有反应或报错，下一步我可以直接帮你补一版“按 F5 调 Neoformat”的完整 gvim 配置。

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="apply_patch"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **apply_patch**</summary>

Apply Patch

**Input:**

- explanation: `Rewrite verible_format.vim to a simple standalone formatter script with F5 mapping for .v, .vh, .sv, and .svh files.`
- input:

```
*** Begin Patch
*** Delete File: c:\Users\man\Desktop\code\verible_format.vim
*** Add File: c:\Users\man\Desktop\code\verible_format.vim
+" ============================================================================
+" Verible formatter mapping for gVim
+" F5: format current .v/.vh/.sv/.svh file using verible-verilog-format
+" ============================================================================
+
+function! FormatWithVerible() abort
+    let l:ext = tolower(expand('%:e'))
+    if index(['v', 'vh', 'sv', 'svh'], l:ext) < 0
+        echohl ErrorMsg
+        echom 'F5 formatter only supports .v .vh .sv .svh files'
+        echohl None
+        return
+    endif
+
+    if executable('verible-verilog-format') == 0
+        echohl ErrorMsg
+        echom 'verible-verilog-format not found in PATH'
+        echohl None
+        return
+    endif
+
+    let l:filepath = expand('%:p')
+    if empty(l:filepath)
+        echohl ErrorMsg
+        echom 'current buffer has no file path'
+        echohl None
+        return
+    endif
+
+    let l:view = winsaveview()
+    silent write
+
+    let l:cmd = 'verible-verilog-format --inplace ' . shellescape(l:filepath)
+    let l:save_shelltemp = &shelltemp
+    set noshelltemp
+    call system(l:cmd)
+    let &shelltemp = l:save_shelltemp
+
+    if v:shell_error != 0
+        echohl ErrorMsg
+        echom 'verible-verilog-format failed (exit code: ' . v:shell_error . ')'
+        echohl None
+        return
+    endif
+
+    edit!
+    call winrestview(l:view)
+    echom 'Formatted with verible-verilog-format'
+endfunction
+
+augroup VeribleFormatKeymap
+    autocmd!
+    autocmd BufRead,BufNewFile *.v,*.vh,*.sv,*.svh nnoremap <buffer> <F5> :call FormatWithVerible()<CR>
+    autocmd BufRead,BufNewFile *.v,*.vh,*.sv,*.svh vnoremap <buffer> <F5> <Esc>:call FormatWithVerible()<CR>
+augroup END
*** End Patch
```

<summary>Edit: **verible_format.vim**</summary>

@@ lines 1-57 @@

```
" ============================================================================
" Verible formatter mapping for gVim
" F5: format current .v/.vh/.sv/.svh file using verible-verilog-format
" ============================================================================

function! FormatWithVerible() abort
    let l:ext = tolower(expand('%:e'))
    if index(['v', 'vh', 'sv', 'svh'], l:ext) < 0
        echohl ErrorMsg
        echom 'F5 formatter only supports .v .vh .sv .svh files'
        echohl None
        return
    endif

    if executable('verible-verilog-format') == 0
        echohl ErrorMsg
        echom 'verible-verilog-format not found in PATH'
        echohl None
        return
    endif

    let l:filepath = expand('%:p')
    if empty(l:filepath)
        echohl ErrorMsg
        echom 'current buffer has no file path'
        echohl None
        return
    endif

    let l:view = winsaveview()
    silent write

    let l:cmd = 'verible-verilog-format --inplace ' . shellescape(l:filepath)
    let l:save_shelltemp = &shelltemp
    set noshelltemp
    call system(l:cmd)
    let &shelltemp = l:save_shelltemp

    if v:shell_error != 0
        echohl ErrorMsg
        echom 'verible-verilog-format failed (exit code: ' . v:shell_error . ')'
        echohl None
        return
    endif

    edit!
    call winrestview(l:view)
    echom 'Formatted with verible-verilog-format'
endfunction

augroup VeribleFormatKeymap
    autocmd!
    autocmd BufRead,BufNewFile *.v,*.vh,*.sv,*.svh nnoremap <buffer> <F5> :call FormatWithVerible()<CR>
    autocmd BufRead,BufNewFile *.v,*.vh,*.sv,*.svh vnoremap <buffer> <F5> <Esc>:call FormatWithVerible()<CR>
augroup END

```
</details></tool-use>

" ============================================================================
" Verible formatter mapping for gVim

" ============================================================================

function! FormatWithVerible() abort
    let l:ext = tolower(expand('%:e'))
    if index(['v', 'vh', 'sv', 'svh'], l:ext) < 0
        echohl ErrorMsg
        echom 'F5 formatter only supports .v .vh .sv .svh files'
        echohl None
        return
    endif

    if executable('verible-verilog-format') == 0
        echohl ErrorMsg
        echom 'verible-verilog-format not found in PATH'
        echohl None
        return
    endif

    let l:filepath = expand('%:p')
    if empty(l:filepath)
        echohl ErrorMsg
        echom 'current buffer has no file path'

        return

        echom 'verible-verilog-format failed (exit code: ' . v:shell_error . ')'
        echohl None
        return
    endif

    edit!
    call winrestview(l:view)
    echom 'Formatted with verible-verilog-format'
endfunction

    autocmd BufRead,BufNewFile *.v,*.vh,*.sv,*.svh nnoremap <buffer> <F5> :call FormatWithVerible()<CR>
